APPROVE

The refactor preserves behaviour: `TargetsRemoved` is the exact negation of the original skip conditions, and the `Any` calls keep the same short-circuit order, with `rule.Print` skipped first. It uses no new APIs or unused parameters, so the build should be unaffected. Cognitive complexity drops well below 15 in `Replaced` (trivial), `RuleReplaces` (roughly 10), and `TargetsRemoved` (about 2).
